tracks.lyrics:
[Intro: low strings, one taiko, the long arm creaks back]

[Verse 1]
Long beams from the bottom of the tub
A pin, a sling, a hinge
A box of loose bricks for a heart
That drops when the arm swings
I can see the camp, the broken cart
The grey flag on its pole
But the ground in front of my own two feet
Is ground I can't control

[Pre-Chorus]
One, the arm comes down
Two, the weight goes low
Three, the stone is in the sky
Four and a half, and throw

[Chorus]
Dead zone, dead zone
Too close for me to throw
I send the fire to the far ones
And I trust the ones below
Dead zone, dead zone
Every stone goes long
I can reach the edge of the baseplate
But the door is not my song

[Verse 2]
The big ones first, that's the order
A boss in reach is mine
Then the farthest one still walking
At the back end of the line
Walls don't hide you, roofs don't hide you
I throw it high and steep
Up at sixty, over the stone
And down where the grey ones creep

[Chorus]
Dead zone, dead zone
Too close for me to throw
I send the fire to the far ones
And I trust the ones below
Dead zone, dead zone
Every stone goes long
I can reach the edge of the baseplate
But the door is not my song

[Bridge: half time, the strings fall away, taiko alone]
You build a thing that sees for miles
And it's blind at its own front step
So the kid built a wall, then a knight, then a pot
Click by click, a castle of help
When the ladder crew comes down the bank
I drop one where their boots will be
And the whole wall shouts "siege broken"
And for once, they're shouting for me

[Final Chorus: full strings, the choir hums under]
Dead zone, dead zone
Too close for me to throw
I send the fire to the far ones
And I trust the ones below
Dead zone, dead zone
Every stone goes long
I can reach the edge of the baseplate
But the door is not my song

[Outro: the arm creaks back, one last low drum]
Four and a half
And throw

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro: fanfare, hooves on the baseplate]

[Verse 1]
White horse, twelve studs high, he don't hurry, he don't flinch
Red plume on a silver lid, a lance that's built an inch
The grey come up the drawbridge like they own the market square
But nobody owns the market square when Brickalot is there

[Verse 2]
He was step forty-seven in a booklet by the bed
A kid pressed every piece in place and here is what it said:
"Hold the gate, hold the keep, hold the line that holds the town"
And a knight who's been clicked together does not come apart that easily

[Pre-Chorus]
He's slow, yeah, he's slow, he's a horse made of bricks
But the gap between his charges is the time it takes to fix

[Chorus]
Sir Brickalot! Level the lance and ride!
Sir Brickalot! One hit, one grey, one side!
Snap, click, the kingdom stands
Built by small and stubborn hands
Sir Brickalot! The castle's on your side

[Verse 3]
They brought a ladder up the north wall on the seventh wave
The archers turned to plastic and the trebuchet was brave
But the stone falls long and the stone falls far and the close ones slip on through
So who's gonna meet them at the keep? I think you know who

[Bridge: half time, the gang hums]
Every brick they knock off, he can click back on
Every night they take the wall, by breakfast it's rebuilt and gone
You can melt a little soldier, you can scatter him like grain
But you can't unbuild a story once a kid has built it plain

[Final Chorus: key up, everyone]
Sir Brickalot! Level the lance and ride!
Sir Brickalot! One hit, one grey, one side!
Snap, click, the kingdom stands
Built by small and stubborn hands
Sir Brickalot! The castle's on your side

[Outro: one last fanfare]
[a single brick clicks into place]

Ayy. Grey plastic. Grey plastic.

Base coat, wash, then I varnish them fine
Ballista on the ridge got a pin in the spine

[name] holding, hold up, hold your post
[name] slow 'em, cold, they ghost
[name] brother stick 'em to the board
Every grey dude get a hue he can't afford

I see 'em coming down the kitchen off the lazy Susan spinning
They thinning, I'm grinning, my minis in the middle of the winning
Night light glowing and the lightbox beaming, [name] gleaming
Wave nine, wave ten, the horde is screaming and I'm dreaming
Of a shelf where they sit, painted, finished, lit
Not a single one of 'em grey, not a bit

Not painted like us. (Grey plastic.) Not painted like us.
